The Art Cafe Experience

Where Manipuri Culinary Heritage Meets a Calm Neighbourhood Sanctuary.

Tucked away at House no.3 on peaceful Seuji Path in Zoo Tiniali, LA- PHOI (Manipuri Art Cafe & Kitchen) celebrates the clean, aromatic flavours of Manipur. Unlike heavy restaurant gravies, Manipuri home cooking relies on fresh seasonal greens, roasted perilla seeds (thoiding), fermented bamboo shoots, and slow-smoked meats that leave you feeling light and nourished.

01

Clean & Soulful

Light on oil and overpowering masalas—crafted with authentic Manipuri herbs, smoked meats, and fresh greens.
